title: Special Array I
summary: An array is special if adjacent elements have different parities.
statement: An array is special if adjacent elements have different parities. Given an array of integers nums, determine if it is special by checking each pair of adjacent elements to ensure one is even and the other is odd, then return true or false accordingly.
constraints: An array is special when every adjacent pair contains one even and one odd value.
A one-element array is special because it has no adjacent violation.
reference_solution:
def is_alternating_parity_array(nums):
    return all((a-b)%2 for a,b in zip(nums,nums[1:]))
hints: Two integers have opposite parity exactly when their difference is odd.
Require the difference modulo two to be nonzero for all pairs.
Universal adjacency checking implements the definition, with the empty set of pairs correctly passing.
editorial: Universal adjacency checking implements the definition, with the empty set of pairs correctly passing.

tests.explanation: There are no adjacent pairs, so the result is true.
